title: Target anatomy
view: Transverse section of the right neck at the interscalene level under a linear probe, seen from the feet as on ultrasound: lateral (posterior neck) on the image left, medial (carotid) on the right.
teachingPoint: C5-C7 stacked in the groove between the scalenes; needle in-plane from lateral through the middle scalene, tip in the groove beside (not on) the roots; the phrenic nerve sits on the anterior scalene, medial to the target.
claims: Right neck in section, lateral on the left, as on ultrasound (house laterality; NYSORA's plate mirrored).
C5-C7 roots stacked between anterior and middle scalenes (record, subtitle).
Phrenic nerve on the anterior scalene; carotid and IJV medial to it (record, subtitle).
Needle in-plane from lateral through the middle scalene, tip in the groove (record, steps 6-7).
Five labels: Middle scalene, C5-C7 roots, Anterior scalene, Phrenic nerve, Carotid.
